## Circular to Licensed Corporations

## Investor Leaflet 'How to Make a Complaint'

We wish to invite you to display and distribute to your clients our new investor leaflet, 'How to Make a Complaint'.

'How  to  Make  a  Complaint'  explains  to  investors  where  they  can  channel  complaints  if misconduct occurs in the securities and futures markets and the SFC's procedures and powers in handling investor complaints. Both the English and Chinese versions of the leaflet are available.

To allow investors to check the availability of the leaflet, the names and addresses of the licensed corporations  distributing  this  leaflet  will  be  posted  on  the  'Publications'  section  of  the  SFCoperated investor portal, the InvestEd website at www.InvestEd.hk.

Please contact Ms Gloria Chan at 2842 7711 concerning requests for copies of the leaflet.

Investor Education and Communications Department
